title: concordance.validate input
description: Validate an Object Catalog manifest against the vendored Concordance wire contract. Provide either an inline `manifest` object OR a relative `manifestPath` to a JSON file. Exactly one of the two is required.

manifest.description: Inline Object Catalog manifest object. Mutually exclusive with manifestPath.

manifestPath.description: Project-relative path to a manifest JSON file. Absolute paths and parent-directory traversal (..) are rejected.

projectRoot.description: Optional override for the project root used to resolve manifestPath. Defaults to process.cwd().

throwOnVersionError.description: When true, a ConcordanceVersionError (major schema_version mismatch) is surfaced as a tool error. When false (default), the same condition is reported as a structured error in the response.
